en.crash.aiPasteHint: After Analyze & write to session, send the prompt in chat. The agent should call tracescope_publish_crash_analysis for auto write-back. If not: click Apply AI reply to pull, or paste the reply first.
en.crash.aiPastePlaceholder: Paste AI reply (root cause, impact, fix…)
en.crash.aiRestoredFromCache: Restored the previous AI conclusion from local cache (no model call). Use Analyze & write to session to re-run; or Clear AI cache first.
en.crash.analyzeLocalHint: Local stack matching done (no AI call). For model conclusions, use Analyze & write to session, then paste the reply back.
en.crash.analyzeVsAiHint: Local analyze only parses the stack and matches repo files. Analyze & write to session sends a job prompt to AI; the agent should call tracescope_publish_crash_analysis so the sidebar auto-writes back.
en.crash.cookieExpired: Cookie expired — update credentials or paste a stack below
en.crash.cookieHint: Copy Cookie from the crash list on apm.umeng.com (needs EGG_SESS). Credentials stay on this machine and are mirrored globally.
en.crash.copyFail: Copy failed — select the text manually
en.crash.crashlyticsHint: Enter the Firebase project ID (or project number) and App ID. Prefer an access token (gcloud auth print-access-token); service accounts often cannot read full topIssues reports. If using a service account: (1) enable Firebase Crashlytics API; (2) grant Firebase Crashlytics Viewer in IAM. System proxy / HTTPS_PROXY is used automatically. Enable “Remember credentials” to persist on this machine.
en.crash.fetchListHint: Fetch anytime after credentials are saved. Expand Settings to edit credentials; expand Filters to change query options
en.crash.filter.optionsEmpty: No options yet (save Cookie, or reload)
en.crash.filter.optionsHelp: Version / OS / device match U-APM. Dimensions are AND (version ∩ OS ∩ device); multi-select within a dimension is OR. Max 10 values per dimension — heavy cross-dimension picks often return 0 rows.
en.crash.filter.optionsMaxHint: Max 10 selections per dimension (same as Umeng console)
en.crash.filter.osDeviceHelp: Options come from the same Umeng meta APIs as the console. Pick values — do not type free text.
en.crash.filter.timeRangeHelp: Pick a preset, or edit the start/end dates for a custom range (editing dates switches to Custom). The range is sent to Umeng when loading the list.
en.crash.filtersCollapsedHint: Click to expand filters (collapsed by default)
en.crash.filtersDirty: Filters changed — click the button to search again
en.crash.filtersIdle: Edit filters, then click Apply filters & search to fetch
en.crash.listEmpty: No crashes listed (save credentials and run probe, or paste a stack if cookie failed)
en.crash.listEmptyFiltered: No matches for this filter (Umeng ANDs version ∩ OS ∩ device). Try version only, or fewer values per dimension; leave a dimension empty for “all”.
en.crash.listEmptyHint: No list data yet. Save credentials, then Apply filters & search or Refresh list (or Probe). If the cookie failed, paste a stack below.
en.crash.noRepoMatch: No stack-referenced source files matched in the repo (common for system frames / incomplete iOS symbolication). You can still write to session for AI, or paste a fuller app stack.
en.crash.pasteRequired: Paste a crash stack trace first
en.crash.probeFail: Fetch failed — check credentials, network, and that Crashlytics API is enabled

en.crash.writeSessionHint: Prompt (with job id) filled into the session composer. Send it; when the agent calls tracescope_publish_crash_analysis, the sidebar writes back automatically. If not, click Apply AI reply or paste the reply.
